name: Cape Santa Maria Beach Resort
primary_cta: Check availability (bookonthenet hand-off); call toll free +1 800-926-9704; email resort@capesantamaria.com
brand_truth: A beach resort at the far northern tip of Long Island where the route is the adventure and the bungalows line the sand.
buyer: US and Canadian couples, families and private pilots planning months ahead, fearing complicated connections.

direction.why: A remote, aviation-flavoured beach resort reads best as a travel feature; flats aqua and channel teal as fields on a cool sand ground.

big_idea: The standfirst is a live sentence: choose where you start and it tells you exactly how you arrive, with the three legs drawn under it.
concept_type: booking: room picker handing off to bookonthenet, route finder, Beach House, getting here page
tier_why: Their own aerial and beach photography in a magazine layout; no 3D.
